function.arguments: {"observation": "The trial was not randomised, and clinicians assigned treatment preferentially to sicker patients. The data shows that the treatment arm has a lower response rate (64.5%) than the control arm (72.7%), but this may be confounded by baseline severity, which is associated with both arm assignment and response.", "implication": "A raw difference in response rates between arms is not a causal treatment effect because the groups are not comparable. We must check whether the arms are balanced on baseline severity. If not, the observed difference may be due to confounding. Therefore, we must cross-tabulate `arm` by `severity` before reporting the raw difference. If imbalance is found, we cannot report the raw difference as a treatment effect without adjustment."}
function.name: note_finding
